source: El Mouden et al. 2006, Journal of Arid Environments 64:422-435
finding: 34 plant species identified; five species accounted for ~70% of identified material.
applicability: T. g. graeca wild population; not direct T. g. ibera captive-feeding evidence

source: Impact of habitat loss on ecological networks... 2019, PMC6894431
finding: Background section describes wild-plant diet including Medicago sativa, thistles, Taraxacum and rosemary, citing prior diet literature.
applicability: species-level secondary ecological statement; not Ibera-direct

source: British Chelonia Group Mediterranean tortoise caresheet
finding: High-fibre, low-fat/protein leafy diet; lists clover, dandelion, plantains and sow thistle among garden forage.
applicability: specialist husbandry guidance; broader than Ibera

source: Bayley & Highfield 1996, Chelonian Conservation and Biology 2(1), T. graeca in Morocco
finding: Table of food plants in the Souss Valley includes Plantago spp., Sonchus oleraceus, Malva spp., Leontodon spp., Medicago lupulina and cultivated Medicago sativa among foods.
applicability: T. g. graeca field evidence in Morocco; not direct T. g. ibera evidence
